The guide to the end-to-end test assets: best-practice knowledge, agent types and governance. It lists each file and gives step-by-step manual and automated test scenarios with the expected outcomes.

## Accuracy
- **Current with the knowledge, process-knowledge, archetype and oversight features.**
- **"All files were checked against the backend"** (stated in the file).
- **The expected outcomes depend on the models,** apart from the offline-computed table in §7.

## Replication notes
